description: This file contains unit tests for the BlockedBloomFilter class used in activation repartitioning within Orleans. It tests the add and check functionalities of the bloom filter.

classes.name: BlockedBloomFilterTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the BlockedBloomFilter functionality in activation repartitioning.

methods.name: AddAndCheck
methods.description: Tests that a sample added to the bloom filter is reported as contained within it.

methods.name: DoesNotContainSome
methods.description: Tests that a sample not added to the bloom filter is reported as not contained.
